rules.title: Writ grammar public entry rules
rules.statement: The Writ data-format grammar exposes exactly the rules { value, map, array, typed_value, typed_collection } as importable entry points; importing grammars may start parsing at any of these and at no other Writ rule.
rules.uncertainty: PEG-tooling directive (grammar-composition surface), not a Logos-source language rule; included as the observable export contract of the Writ literal sub-grammar.
